title: 中焦标准视角约53度
content: 4×5画幅配5英寸焦距镜头时视角约53°，属于室内外通用的一般工作视角，适合常规取景。
quote: A lens of 5-inch focal length, used on a 4 x 5 plate, will include an angle of view of 53°.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 固定焦点免对焦
content: Williamson等相机在特定距离内因光圈固定焦点而无需对焦，适合日常拍摄；只有需要严格对焦时才启用毛面胶片检查。
quote: With the Williamson camera focussing is unnecessary within certain distances owing to the fixed foci of the stops.

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 闪光前后开合快门
content: 一切就绪后先打开镜头或快门、揭开感光板，闪光前几秒的曝光有助于整体照明；闪光一结束立即遮住镜头并合上片盒。
quote: Immediately after the flash, however, the lens should be covered, and the plate-holder closed.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 干燥前除净表面水分
content: 上晾干架前须用湿麂皮仔细擦去胶片表面水分，否则会轻微渗色、挤水不足导致着色不匀。
quote: Always carefully remove any surface moisture from the film with a damp chamois, before drying.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 闪光间距过大的后果
content: 两个闪光点不可相距过远，否则会产生混乱的照明和交叉阴影。
quote: Care must be exercised that the flashes are not too far apart, or confused lighting and crossed shadows will result.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 聚光镜尺寸宁大勿小
content: 为给定底片选配聚光镜时，应选直径足够大的型号，避免因聚光镜过小造成底片边缘受光不足。
quote: it is always best to have the condensers of ample size for a given negative

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 局部补光压暗部反差
content: 人工光下阴影生硬沉重、反差刺眼时，用多盏灯分散布置在镜头视野之外做局部照明，照亮最暗区域以缓和反差。
quote: Skilful local lighting by lamps placed here and there, out of the range of the lens

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 人造光仅限目视比对
content: 人造光经漫射修正后可用于有限范围的色彩工作，但目前只限于目视匹配与任意比较，不能用于记录性拍摄。
quote: In the case of artificial lights, their use is, as yet, limited to visual matching (not recording) and arbitrary comparisons.

source_ref.title: Light and Colour Theories, and their relation to light and colour standardization
source_ref.author: Joseph W. Lovibond

title: 缩小复制无皮腔难题
content: 从大原稿翻拍小尺寸复制品时，皮腔延伸不足的问题不会出现；只有等大或放大复制才需要两倍焦距的延伸量。
quote: As long as it is a question merely of making a small reproduction from a large original the difficulty does not appear.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 日光放大机底片放置
content: 使用日光放大机时，底片倒置放入片夹，正对毛玻璃中心，并朝向工作间一侧。
quote: the negative is placed in the holder opposite the center of the ground-glass, upside down and facing into the work room

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 光圈档位与曝光倍增
content: 光圈每收小一档（如 f/4→f/5.6→f/8），进光量减半，所需曝光时间加倍；相邻档位孔径差异虽小，对曝光影响显著。
quote: the exposure being doubled with every diminution of the stop up to the limits of the diaphragm

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 光圈环六档刻度
content: 光圈环旋转行程分为六个固定刻度，对应 f/3.5、f/4、f/5.6、f/8、f/11、f/16，孔径从约 3/5 英寸递减到 1/8 英寸，可微调以适应任意光线。
quote: the total rotary travel of the ring is graduated to six different definite points or as many different sized apertures

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 调色片须上银幕判断
content: 判断调色效果必须在放映银幕上观察，不能只看手中的胶片：有些调色片手持看有色，投到银幕上却接近黑白。
quote: when judging any particular tone, it is absolutely necessary to view the image on the screen.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 单闪光宜用广角短焦
content: 单次闪光的光线较局部且强度衰减极快，因此短焦（广角）镜头比长焦镜头更有优势。
quote: a short focus lens (wide angle) will give definite advantage over one of longer focus.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 反射光损失不可硬套
content: 反射面造成的入射光损失量随光源不同而变化，不能把某次测得的反射损失比例硬套到所有光照条件下。
quote: The difference between the two curves is the loss of light incident on reflection, but this must not be rigidly interpreted for all cases

source_ref.title: Light and Colour Theories, and their relation to light and colour standardization
source_ref.author: Joseph W. Lovibond

title: 用表格确定镜头距离
content: 可查表确定给定放大倍率下镜头到底片和屏幕的距离，该表覆盖常规需求，可用于搭建放大设备。
quote: There are tables which show exactly the distance which the lens must be from the negative and screen in order to get an enlargement of a given size

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 酸停浴抑制渗色
content: 可用酸性停浴或在染浴中加酸来改变渗色，但渗色本质上是染料自身属性，选料时仍应以低渗色为准则。
quote: It is possible in some cases to modify this bleeding by an acid “stop bath,” or by adding acid to the dye-bath

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 混染浴色调漂移
content: 含多种染料的染浴中，酸对不同染料影响不一，随染浴耗尽与酸度变化色调会逐渐改变；因此加酸法只对单一染料的染浴可靠。
quote: as the dye-bath becomes exhausted and the acid content changes, the tint obtained will gradually change also.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 镜头固定方式取舍
content: 固定尺寸放大可用延长箱体并把镜头装在末端，但调整余地太小不推荐；双箱套叠稍好仍不理想；最佳方案是把相机直接对接底片盒开口，可翻转后背相机最易实现。
quote: It is far better to adapt one's camera to the apparatus, and this can always be done

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 漫射日光作标准白
content: 在需要色彩一致性的拍摄中，以漫射日光作为标准白光源；它是目前唯一满足射线均衡条件的光，直射阳光和多数人造光都不满足。
quote: Up to the present diffused daylight is the only light which complies with the condition of ray equality.

source_ref.title: Light and Colour Theories, and their relation to light and colour standardization
source_ref.author: Joseph W. Lovibond

title: 遮光罩防直射阳光
content: 夏季太阳近乎头顶时，在窗框外侧、毛玻璃上方一定距离加遮光罩，挡住直射阳光，避免光线过斜造成照明不均。
quote: It is placed on the outside of the window-frame, some distance above the ground-glass, and shields the latter from the direct rays of the sun

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 室内人像曝光加半档
content: 室内拍人像时，在正常测光所得曝光基础上乘以1.5倍作为完整曝光量，例如正常2秒则给4秒。
quote: We remember the rule to multiply normal exposure by 1½ for portraits indoors, and give 4 seconds as a full exposure.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 翻拍题材与用途
content: 家庭翻拍的对象包括老式达盖尔银版、锡版、褪色肖像、绘画、地图、文凭与手稿，也可从合影中单独放大某一人物的头像。
quote: The object to be copied may be an old Daguerreotype, tintype, or faded portrait

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 毛面胶片收纳
content: 对焦完成后取出毛面胶片并妥善存放，可用图钉将其钉在机内底面，以便下次需要时能立即找到。
quote: It is a good plan to clinch it to the bottom inner surface of the camera with drawing pins, for it can then be found when it is wanted.

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 染色液配比调中间色
content: 将J、K、L三种染液按不同比例混合，可像染色一样得到中间色，用于精确控制画面色调。
quote: By mixing the dye-baths J, K, and L in varying proportions intermediate colors may be obtained just as in tinting.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 调色后染色速度更快
content: 已调色的胶片（A、F调除外）比未调色胶片吸色更快；若要复现样片效果，须相应稀释染液。
quote: toned film (except tones A and F) absorbs the dye more quickly than untoned film

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 广角需收小光圈保画质
content: 广角镜头在大光圈下画面四角与中心的清晰度和照度可能不均，需显著收小光圈（如f/11、f/18）来改善边缘成像与照明。
quote: Whether the negative would be well defined or equally lighted at the corners and centre of the plate is another story.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 先定标准光强再放大
content: 开始放大前，先用一张好底片试出最适合它的光强，作为同类底片的标准，再按具体底片或放大倍率调整光强。
quote: the worker should work with one good negative until he finds out exactly what light-intensity is best suited to it

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 快门速度固定时的补偿
content: 当摄影机手柄转速固定、无法延长曝光时间时，收小光圈造成的曝光不足必须靠提高被摄场景光照强度来补偿，而非延长曝光。
quote: Instead of increasing the duration of the exposure we must have a greater intensity of light for _f_/5·6 than for _f_/4.

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 皮腔不足的三种解法
content: 当皮腔伸长量不足以做等大翻拍时，按优先级依次考虑：换用双倍延伸皮腔相机、换短焦（广角）镜头、或自制不透光木质前延伸板把镜头前移，以补足镜头与感光板之间的距离。
quote: If we have a double-extension its extra length of bellows will help us out of the difficulty.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 染料耐光耐热与二色性
content: 所选染料不得因受热或受光而褪色，也不得具有二色性（稀释时变色）。
keywords: 染料耐光耐热与二色性
quote: The dyes should not fade on exposure to heat or light and should not be “dichroic” or change color on dilution.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 三原色配色法
content: 把色调理解为红、黄、蓝三色的组合：橙=黄+红，紫=红+蓝，绿=黄+蓝，棕=红+黄+蓝三色混合。
quote: Colors such as orange are made by mixing yellow and red, violet by mixing red and blue, and green by mixing yellow and blue.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 读灯人物摆姿求支撑
content: 拍人物在桌旁灯下阅读时，把脸置于阴影中，姿势安排要放松并给身体充分支撑，避免僵硬。
quote: The face is in shadow and the pose was arranged to give ease and abundant support to the figure.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 小光圈长曝光拍静物
content: 拍室内静物可用极小光圈（如f/22）配合长曝光（如16分钟），以兼顾景深与暗光下的曝光量。
quote: we give an exposure of 16 minutes with _f_/22.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 小房间用广角镜头
content: 拍摄小房间或空间受限的室内时，应改用专用广角镜头（视角可达100°以上），以在狭窄空间内纳入更多环境。
quote: For interiors of small rooms, or wherever the space is confined, a special wide-angle lens is indicated

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 车轮辐条频闪效应
content: 拍摄旋转车轮时，若在快门遮挡期间辐条移动的角度恰好等于相邻辐条夹角（如四辐条为90度），则每帧辐条位置重合，放映时辐条看似静止，而轮缘仍在移动，产生滑行错觉。
quote: when the four pictures are thrown successively upon the screen they will look exactly alike. The spokes will appear to be quite stationary

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 延时摄影的间歇驱动
content: 拍摄长时间间隔的延时镜头时，用时钟触点按秒/分/小时触发电机，每次只让机件转一圈完成一次曝光并把胶片推进一格，间隔可按需设定。
quote: The contacts may be disposed to coincide with intervals of a second, a minute, an hour, or more between successive exposures.

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 只留主体隐去环境
content: 拍摄静物场景（如摆好的餐桌）时，可只让主体与陈设受光，其余部分沉入阴影中隐藏，以突出主体。
quote: We desire only the table and its arrangement; all else may be hidden in shadow.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 单灯侧顶光拍睡姿
content: 拍熟睡人物可用单只磨砂玻璃罩灯，置于主体上方约4英尺并偏一侧，灯不入画，形成柔和侧顶光。
quote: It was made by the light of a single gas-jet enclosed in a ground-glass globe, and fixed about 4 feet above and at one side of the crib.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 放大屏需大于相纸
content: 放大屏必须明显大于所用最大相纸尺寸，以便留出相纸位置调整余量；屏面最好覆白纸或细吸墨纸以辅助对焦。
quote: it must be considerably larger than the largest sheet of bromide paper which is to be used

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 金属亚铁氰化物色相
content: 无机调色剂中金属亚铁氰化物最适用：铁（正铁）亚铁氰化物为蓝色，铜亚铁氰化物为红色，铀亚铁氰化物为红棕色。
quote: Iron (ferric) ferrocyanide is blue, Copper ferrocyanide is red, and Uranium ferrocyanide is reddish brown.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 底片盒需大于底片
content: 日光放大时，底片盒每边至少比最大底片大两英寸，否则边缘区域收不到斜射光线，底片照明不均匀；用直射阳光时尤其重要。
quote: The necessity for having the box at least two inches larger each way than the largest negative from which enlargements are to be made

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 染色后水洗至高光清透
content: 染色达到目标色调后，须冲洗至高光区清透为止，避免高光被染色污染。
keywords: 染色后水洗至高光清透
quote: When the desired tone is obtained rinse until the highlights are clear.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 色调比较的表述法
content: 比较两种色调时，用“更红、更黄、更蓝”来描述差异，并据此进行匹配。
quote: it is usual to say that one is redder, yellower or bluer than the other, and the two may therefore be matched accordingly.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 自制毛面胶片
content: 毛面胶片丢失时，取一小段废胶片，刮去明胶乳剂，用砂纸或粗糙石面打磨赛璐珞表面即可自制；建议随身携带几英寸废胶片备用。
quote: Take a small bit of waste film; scrape off the gelatine emulsion; and rough the celluloid surface with a piece of sandpaper

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 染料槽沉淀的成因
content: 水中微量明矾或铁会使染料析出，在槽内形成沉淀；许多地区用明矾净水，极微量即可让部分染料脱离溶液。
quote: This is due to the precipitation of the dye by small traces of alum or iron in the water supply.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 测光表朝向光源
content: 测光时把测光表置于主体所在阴影位置并正对光源方向，以取得该受光条件下的读数。
quote: We expose the meter, facing the light source, in the shadow of the rose-bowl near the centre of the table.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 强直射光需先衰减
content: 测量或拍摄强直射光时，因不可吸收的红光成分会妨碍完全吸收，须先用已知漫射值的介质遮挡，或经白色表面反射一次，再做处理；漫射量随光强增大而增加。
quote: Such lights must first be modified by intercepting media of known diffusive value, or by reflection from a white surface.

source_ref.title: Light and Colour Theories, and their relation to light and colour standardization
source_ref.author: Joseph W. Lovibond

title: 染料槽起泡的处理
content: 用Cine Scarlet、Cine Orange、Cine Green在转鼓上染色时会起泡，只要让转鼓缓慢旋转即可避免麻烦。
quote: no inconvenience will be caused if the drum is revolved slowly.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 油斑反射不可靠
content: 用油斑（grease spot）装置做反射测光时结果不可靠，因为油膜受特定吸收定律支配，会改变反射光值。
quote: Light reflected from grease is not above suspicion, it being governed by the law of specific absorption already dealt with.

source_ref.title: Light and Colour Theories, and their relation to light and colour standardization
source_ref.author: Joseph W. Lovibond

title: 纯黑靠对比实现
content: 画面中要得到接近理想黑的效果，应让黑色区域与周围亮部形成对比，而不是依赖颜料本身；可用内壁涂黑的箱体开孔，使进入孔内的光无法反射回镜头，从而在亮环境对比下呈现近乎全黑。
quote: The nearest approach to ideal black by contrast, is to view a hole in a box with a blackened interior

source_ref.title: Light and Colour Theories, and their relation to light and colour standardization
source_ref.author: Joseph W. Lovibond

title: 直射阳光的高强度
content: 直射阳光打在白色反光板上可获得高强度光线，适合需要高亮度的放大曝光。
quote: The direct sun on the white reflector will give a light of high intensity.

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 染色前不可放映
content: 胶片上的油脂会造成条纹与着色不匀，因此染色前绝不要放映胶片。
quote: Grease on the film. Never project film before tinting.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 染色温度上限
content: 胶片染色时染浴温度不得超过70°F，否则明胶易软化；若必须加酸，温度更须控制在70°F以下。
quote: By working at temperatures not higher than 70 degrees F.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 辐条倒转错觉
content: 若快门遮挡期间辐条移动角度小于相邻辐条夹角，则放映时辐条呈现与车轮前进方向相反的视觉运动。
quote: the spokes move less than the angle (AB) between them, producing apparent backward motion of the spokes while the wheel is running forwards

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 小幅放大的镜头位置
content: 若放大尺寸仅略大于底片，镜头需外移，使其到底片距离略小于到屏幕距离。
quote: the lens must be racked out until its distance from the negative is but little less than its distance from the screen

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 附加镜缩短焦距
content: 若既无长皮腔也无短焦镜头，可在原镜头遮光罩上加装附加翻拍镜（如Ideal Copying Lens），通过缩短组合焦距来获得所需放大倍率与清晰度。
quote: A still simpler plan is to make use of a supplementary lens

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 对焦管直视取景
content: 若机身带对焦管，只需打开机侧插入毛面胶片，把伸缩管推到最长抵住片门，取下机身后盖上的盖帽，像用望远镜一样从管中直视，即可正对屏幕对焦，避免斜视毛面胶片。
quote: he is able to look squarely upon his screen.

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 动态主体需快镜头
content: 若要在人工光下拍摄有生命、会动的主体，必须使用消像散或其他快作用镜头，并做好费心与耐心的准备。
quote: we will need an anastigmat or other quick-working lens if life subjects are to be attempted

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 双色调分层法
content: 要得到阴影与半调不同色的双色调：先在A调色液中部分调色（65–70°F，3–4分钟），使半调完全调色而阴影仅部分调色，水洗10分钟后在蓝色调色液H中完成，阴影残留银被调成蓝色，得到阴影深蓝、半调红棕的效果。
quote: so that the half-tones are completely toned but the shadows only partially

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 染色前禁过放映机
content: 要获得一致的色调结果，胶片在染色或调色之前绝不能先经过放映机。
quote: If uniform results are to be obtained, film should never be passed through the projector before either tinting or toning.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 增大倍率的调焦方式
content: 要获得更大放大倍率，将镜头后移并同时把屏幕移远，两者配合调整。
quote: To make the enlargement greater we simply rack back the lens and move the screen further off

source_ref.title: Bromide Printing and Enlarging
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 视角由焦距与画幅决定
content: 视角大小由镜头焦距与画幅基线之比决定：焦距相对画幅越长视角越窄，越短视角越宽；可用画幅基线除以等效焦距来估算视角。
keywords: 视角由焦距与画幅决定
quote: This is known as the angle of view, and may be determined by dividing the base measurement of the plate by the equivalent focus of the lens.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 晨昏光强随时间变化
content: 记录晨光与暮光的光强随时间变化，可用于确定阅读所需的最低亮度、不同距离观看物体所需亮度，以及颜色在视觉上消失的界限。
quote: records of intensity changes by time, in Morning and Evening light, and are of interest, as bearing on the lowest luminosities for reading

source_ref.title: Light and Colour Theories, and their relation to light and colour standardization
source_ref.author: Joseph W. Lovibond

title: 调色置换银盐得中间调
content: 调色的目的是用上述化合物或其混合物部分或全部置换构成影像的金属银，从而获得中间色调。
keywords: 调色置换银盐得中间调
quote: It is the object in toning to replace the metallic silver composing the image more or less by one of the above compounds or by a mixture of these.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 染料渗色控制
content: 选择染料时须选渗色倾向最小者；染色后水洗5分钟内只允许极少量染料洗出，否则表面水滴会饱和染料，干燥后形成银幕上可见的斑点与不规则痕迹。
quote: the rate of removal of the dye should be slow and only a slight amount should wash out in a period of, say, five minutes.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 闪光点远离易燃物
content: 选择闪光点时必须避开蕾丝窗帘等易燃织物，并在闪光点下方放托盘接住落下的火星或燃烧碎屑。
quote: we must avoid proximity to lace curtains or similar inflammable fabrics.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 调色温度与时间
content: 铜调色最佳效果的温度为65–70°F，调色时间5–10分钟，随后水洗10分钟。
quote: _Temperature of Toning_—To obtain the best results the temperature of the bath should be from 65 degrees to 70 degrees F.

source_ref.title: Tinting and toning of Eastman positive motion picture film
source_ref.author: Eastman Kodak Company

title: 镜面反光的排查
content: 闪光前用点燃的蜡烛放在闪光点位置，从相机方向观察镜子或画框玻璃是否反射强光；若有反射，把镜面或玻璃倾斜到看不见反光的角度。
quote: This may be determined by holding a lighted taper at the point where the flash will be made.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 闪光点的最佳位置
content: 闪光点置于相机后方约两英尺、侧向两三英尺并略高于相机处，可让阴影方向自然、获得理想的立体感。
quote: The best general effect is produced by flashing the light about two feet behind, and two or three feet at one side and slightly above the camera.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 双闪光的间距与位置
content: 需要两次闪光时，等第一次闪光烟雾散尽后，在距第一闪光点约四英尺、且与第一闪光点成一直线的位置补第二次闪光，以扩大照明范围。
quote: a second flash should be given at a point about four feet away, and in line with the first flash.

source_ref.title: Photography at home
source_ref.author: John A. Tennant

title: 超慢速逐格曝光
content: 需要比常规更慢的速率时，采用“转一圈拍一格”的方式，把电机间歇接入与断开，使曝光间隔从每20秒一次延长到每小时一次甚至更长。
quote: the exposure could be varied from once in 20 seconds to once in an hour or more

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 毛玻璃对焦法
content: 需要精确对焦时，打开机侧、抬起片门压板，在片门窗口插入约2英寸的毛面胶片（毛面朝镜头），转动摇柄使镜头开启，影像投在毛面胶片上，再旋动镜头上的对焦螺丝直至影像足够锐利。
quote: inserts into the gate window a small length, about 2 inches, of matt film, with the matt side towards the lens.

source_ref.title: Practical Cinematography and Its Applications
source_ref.author: Frederick Arthur Ambrose Talbot

title: 黑是减量非能量
content: 黑色不是与彩色并列的主动能量，而是一个“负量”，只能通过与原始光的对比被辨识；反射光由显出的色彩加上未被吸收的残余白光组成，布光时应把黑理解为对光的削减而非一种颜色。
quote: black is not itself an active energy analogous to colour, but is a minus quantity distinguishable by contrast with the original light

source_ref.title: Light and Colour Theories, and their relation to light and colour standardization
source_ref.author: Joseph W. Lovibond

title: 双胶合镜组间距规律
content: Petzval 等双胶合镜头中，两片消色差镜组的间距约为焦距的三分之二；不同厂商有差异，但总体趋势是焦距越长、两镜组间距越大。
quote: the _distance_ between these components is usually about two-thirds of the focal length.

source_ref.title: Optical Projection. Part 1: The Projection of Lantern Slides
source_ref.author: Wright, Lewis, 1838-1905; Wright, Russell Stuart

title: 从舞台化到电影化表演
content: 《猪巷火枪手》代表了更适合电影的表演方式的发展；拍摄时应减少舞台式的夸张外放，转向更贴合镜头尺度的内敛表演。
quote: this film represents the more film-appropriate mode of acting that developed.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 手持机规格取舍
content: 为艺术性抓拍设计的手持机应轻便可折叠、能放入口袋，画幅不超过4.5×3.5英寸，配长焦直线风景镜头与良好快门，顶部装轻便测景器。
quote: It should be able to take pictures not larger than four and a half by three and a half inches, and should be fitted with the Eastman spools

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 长焦更适合绘画性构图
content: 为获得适合绘画性（pictorial）目的的视角，应优先选用长焦镜头，因其给出的视角比短焦更合适。
quote: the long-focus lenses give more suitable angles of view for pictorial purposes.

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 北向顶光作主光
content: 人像棚拍以朝北的大窗作主光：窗宽11英尺、高9英尺，顶部向外倾斜2.5英尺，不设其他顶光与垂直侧光；主光窗底距地面3英尺，可绕光位移动拍摄而无需遮光板或反光板。
quote: the "light of lights" is the north one, and that is a large fixed window 11 by 9 feet with a single slope of two and a half feet in the height

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 三层景深结构
content: 任何画面都应组织出前景、中景、背景三个层次，使空间有纵深可读，避免画面扁平。
quote: In any image there is a foreground, a midground, and a background

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 取景辅助工具需绘画基础
content: 使用Camera Lucida等取景辅助工具前，须先具备素描基础；否则棱镜中看到的画面虽美，落到纸上只剩令人沮丧的痕迹。
quote: its use required a previous knowledge of drawing, which unfortunately I did not possess

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 侦探相机免三脚架持机
content: 使用侦探相机拍摄时，无需三脚架或支架，将相机夹在腋下、贴于身体侧面持稳后曝光，适合快速抓拍与隐蔽机位。
quote: This Camera is made to carry in the hand, and is held against the side under the arm while exposures are made. A tripod or stand is not required.

source_ref.title: Photography in the studio and in the field
source_ref.author: Estabrooke, Edward M., 1838-1903

title: 按感光材料选光色
content: 使用对色光敏感的感光材料时，应选择不会影响该片种感光特性的有色光，避免色光改变成像结果。
quote: Colored light is made of the correct quality which does not affect photographic plates of various sensibilities.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 油灯安全布局
content: 使用石蜡灯时，储油罐应远低于燃烧室，使其不会被过度加热，从而消除使用中的危险。
quote: the reservoir containing the paraffine is far below the combustion-chamber, and therefore it cannot become unduly heated

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 干板不平的误差
content: 做上述对焦测试时须计入普通干板并不完全平整这一因素，底片本身的翘曲会造成可察觉的误差，不能全归因于镜头。
quote: ordinary dry plates are not quite flat, and the error of the plate may make an appreciable difference.

source_ref.title: The Barnet Book of Photography: A Collection of Practical Articles
source_ref.author: Various

title: 大光圈对平行度要求更高
content: 像场平坦时若要用大光圈，必须比以往更严格地保证底片与镜头光轴垂直；若像面弯曲而底片平直，结果只能是折中。
quote: to take full advantage of the larger apertures when the field is flat, much more care than has been usual must be devoted to this matter.

source_ref.title: The Barnet Book of Photography: A Collection of Practical Articles
source_ref.author: Various

title: 预对焦标尺估距拍摄
content: 先用毛玻璃对好各距离的焦点，并在相机顶部调焦杆上标出对应刻度；实拍时撤掉毛玻璃，目测被摄物距离后把调焦杆推到对应标记即可合焦。
quote: the position of the focussing lever on top of the Camera is marked for each distance. After this the ground glass may be entirely dispensed with

source_ref.title: Photography in the studio and in the field
source_ref.author: Estabrooke, Edward M., 1838-1903

title: 聚光镜与物镜分工
content: 光学系统分两组：聚光镜（condenser）负责收集灯光并把光线改向、均匀穿过幻灯片；物镜（objective）负责放大画面并投到银幕上。布光时先保证聚光镜把光收满并覆盖片门，再用物镜成像。
quote: There are two sets of lenses: one being known as the condenser, and the other as the objective.

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 按中心明暗调灯距
content: 光斑中心偏亮时把光源移近聚光镜；中心偏暗时把光源后拉，直到整个圆斑均匀明亮。
quote: If it now resembles E, the light must be moved nearer the condenser; if, on the contrary, the centre is dark, it must be drawn back

source_ref.title: Optical Projection. Part 1: The Projection of Lantern Slides
source_ref.author: Wright, Lewis, 1838-1905; Wright, Russell Stuart

title: 光塑造被摄体
content: 光既塑造雕塑所依据的模型，也塑造完成后的作品；拍摄任何物体或群体时，其外观由光的方向、分布与性质决定。
quote: The direction, distribution, and quality of light influence the appearance of all objects and groups of them.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 发光点越小越需精调
content: 光源发光点越小，光心调整越须精确；像石蜡油灯这类大面积发光体没有调心装置，因其辐射面大而无需精确对中。
quote: generally speaking the smaller the luminous point, the more exact must the operation be.

source_ref.title: Optical Projection. Part 1: The Projection of Lantern Slides
source_ref.author: Wright, Lewis, 1838-1905; Wright, Russell Stuart

title: 四元件光路顺序
content: 光路中聚光镜、光源、幻灯片、物镜的相对位置按图示排列：光源在聚光镜后，幻灯片置于聚光镜前方，物镜在幻灯片之后成像。
quote: The relative positions of condenser, light, slide, and objective are indicated in the diagram to which attention has just been called, Fig. 1.

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 侧视分解动作
content: 分解动物行走或奔跑的步态时，采用侧面平视机位，逐相记录单一步幅内各足的依次落地。
quote: LATERAL elevation of some consecutive phases of action by representative horses.

source_ref.title: The Science of Animal Locomotion (Zoopraxography) An Electro-Photographic Investigation of Consecutive Phases of Animal Movements
source_ref.author: Muybridge, Eadweard, 1830-1904

title: 合焦即点对点重聚
content: 判断镜头是否合焦的标准：物体上每一点发出的所有光线须重新汇聚到像面上对应的一个确定点，画面质量取决于该功能是否准确。
quote: all the rays proceeding from any one point on the object are re-converged (when the lens is in focus) to a definite point on the image

source_ref.title: Optical Projection. Part 1: The Projection of Lantern Slides
source_ref.author: Wright, Lewis, 1838-1905; Wright, Russell Stuart

title: 大景别背景衬人物
content: 可大胆用大面积风景作背景来托住人物，不必担心背景占比过大，人物仍能从中凸显。
quote: another example of the fearlessness of that artist in putting in or backing up his figures with a large amount of landscape background.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 镜头验收需实测
content: 同类镜头个体差异大，且多为批量进口，验收前应要求对实际使用的该台放映机做演示测试，而非仅凭型号规格接受。
quote: the customer does well to insist upon a demonstration of his own particular lantern before acceptance.

source_ref.title: Optical Projection. Part 1: The Projection of Lantern Slides
source_ref.author: Wright, Lewis, 1838-1905; Wright, Russell Stuart

title: 静默制造张力
content: 在关键段落抽掉声音（对白、配乐、环境声），用静默替代音效来积累不安与压迫感。
quote: Note how he uses silence

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 直射加反射潜力更大
content: 在反射光之上叠加"原光"（直射光），其表现潜力远大于单用反射光；布光时把直射光与反射光组合使用。
quote: the combination of "primary" light with reflected light possesses much greater potentiality than the latter alone

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 窗外运动暗示画外世界
content: 在室内镜头中安排窗外或画外的人物走动，用画外运动暗示场景之外生活仍在继续，扩展画面外的世界感。
quote: Note the people moving on the other side of the window

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 描图只留纪念性轮廓
content: 在暗箱投影上手工描摹时，不要试图复制纸上所有细节，那会耗尽耐心与技巧；只取景物的主要轮廓，得到的是场景的纪念性速写而非精确复制。
quote: it baffles the skill and patience of the amateur to trace all the minute details visible on the paper

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 自然光增强可信度
content: 坚持使用自然光拍摄，即使器材感光度不足导致拍摄困难，也以牺牲便利换取画面的可信度与真实感。
quote: He insisted on natural light

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 平凡人物的缺陷塑造
content: 塑造普通主角时，给他加入虚荣、自负等缺陷，使观众对角色的关注因不完美而更尖锐、更有张力。
quote: There’s something pretentious, vain, and flawed in his character. This makes our sense of interest in him even more poignant

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 复合镜头测焦距
content: 复合镜头（如Petzval）光学中心不在两组之间，不能直接量取；应正反各测一次同一参考点到像面的距离，取两次测量的平均值作为实际焦距。
quote: then turning it round and taking a second measurement from the _same_ point, the mean between the two measurements giving the actual focus.

source_ref.title: Optical Projection. Part 1: The Projection of Lantern Slides
source_ref.author: Wright, Lewis, 1838-1905; Wright, Russell Stuart

title: 按画面尺寸定距离
content: 已知镜头焦距与所需画面直径时，用（画面直径×镜头焦距）÷幻灯片直径求出镜头到银幕所需距离（英尺），据此摆位。
quote: Diameter of picture × Focus of lens (in feet) (in inches) ------------------------------------ = Distance required (in feet).

source_ref.title: Optical Projection. Part 1: The Projection of Lantern Slides
source_ref.author: Wright, Lewis, 1838-1905; Wright, Russell Stuart

title: 布景服装按光设计
content: 布景与服装的颜色必须按灯光效果来设计，因为光色变化会改变它们的呈现；光色与绘景颜色需对应考虑。
quote: The scenery and costumes should be considered in terms of the lighting effects because they are affected by changes in the color of the light.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 例外镜头配对应背景
content: 常规镜头可用通用背景，但特殊角度或特殊构图的镜头必须配以与之透视对应的专门背景，不可沿用标准背景。
quote: Exceptional pictures should have corresponding backgrounds.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 首尾摇臂镜呼应
content: 开场用摇臂镜建立空间，结尾让同一摇臂镜复现，用机位与运动的重复形成首尾结构呼应，使段落闭合。
quote: Notice the crane shot at the beginning – why does it return at the end? Why is it important?

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 双人同名的对位镜
content: 当两个角色构成镜像/双重关系时，用构图与机位上的押韵镜头（相似景别、相似角度）反复对位，让观众感到二者互为映照。
quote: Two Charlies: rhyming shots

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 逆光时须遮挡镜头
content: 当太阳正对镜头时，光线会在镜筒黄铜内壁反射形成眩光光斑；因此曝光期间必须对镜头做遮光处理。
quote: it is for that reason that the lens must be carefully shaded during exposure, when the sun is directly in front of the camera.

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 光源本身入画扩量程
content: 当明暗层次仍不够时，可把光源本体纳入画面，用其自身亮度继续延伸亮度标尺，突破反射介质的明度上限。
quote: there remains the possibility of employing the light-sources themselves in extending the scale of brightness

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 示意相位需标注存疑
content: 当某相位为推测而非实拍时，应在图注中标明其可疑或可能，不要把推测相位当作确证记录使用。
quote: In the conjectural stride No. 10, phase 3 is very doubtful, phases 5 and 7 seem probable in a very long stride.

source_ref.title: The Science of Animal Locomotion (Zoopraxography) An Electro-Photographic Investigation of Consecutive Phases of Animal Movements
source_ref.author: Muybridge, Eadweard, 1830-1904

title: 字幕出现作段落信号
content: 当结尾是被外部要求追加的、与全片基调不同的段落时，可在该段落首次引入字幕/文字，用形式的突变标记叙事转折。
quote: It’s a signal of the transition into this demanded ending.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 表演风格与角色一致
content: 当表演显得夸张过火时，先判断它是否与角色本身的夸张性格一致；若一致，则保留这种外化表演，用表演幅度映射人物内在状态。
quote: Some people might say that the acting is a bit heavy-handed, but keep in mind that it reflects the heavy-handedness of the character himself.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 戏剧表演幅度随距离
content: 当观众与演员距离远（如舞台或早期固定全景）时，表演必须更夸张、更风格化才能被看清；随着镜头靠近、景别变小，表演应转为更安静克制的模式。
quote: Theatrical acting is broader, more stylized, because viewers were so far away

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 默片配乐非真静默
content: 所谓默片并非无声放映，现场始终有乐队或钢琴伴奏；因此设计默片段落时，声音层（现场音乐）与画面是同时存在的独立通道。
quote: Silent films were never really silent – there was live music played along with them.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 日常空间藏危险
content: 把威胁安排在门后、窗外等最寻常的空间里，用平静的美国小镇/家庭场景作底，让暴力从最不可能处爆发。
quote: The opening: behind any door or window...

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 二次转印反转影调
content: 把已曝光的感光纸与第二张感光纸紧压贴合再置于阳光下，得到与第一张相反的影像：底为白、像为深，即一次转印实现影调反转。
quote: the second paper is found to have received an image of a contrary kind to the first; the ground being white, and the image upon it dark.

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 摄影机即观众视线
content: 把摄影机的运动设计为观众注视行为的具身表达：机位的移动对应观众视线的转移与选择，而非纯技术调度。
quote: The camera is an expression of the audience’s gaze

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 舞台是光影之画
content: 把整个舞台视为一幅由光、影、色构成的动态画面（外加台词与音乐），其光影经营应与绘画同等用心。
quote: The stage as a whole is a mobile picture in light, shade, and color with the addition of words and music.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 镜头即眼、感光纸即视网膜
content: 把物镜理解为仪器的眼睛、感光纸理解为视网膜，据此判断取景与曝光：眼睛看什么，画面就记录什么。
quote: The object glass is the _eye_ of the instrument—the sensitive paper may be compared to the _retina._

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 机位远近改变大小
content: 把相机（暗箱）靠近或远离雕塑，可改变成像大小，这是第三个可调变量；与光位、旋转叠加后，同一雕塑能产生大量不同效果。
quote: the change of size which is produced in the image by bringing the Camera Obscura nearer to the statue or removing it further off

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 压暗环境提亮主体
content: 投影放大影像前先把环境压暗（darkened room），使屏幕上的放大影像成为唯一亮部，观众注意力被强制集中到被检视的细节上。
quote: The room was darkened, and images of the two signatures, enormously magnified, were thrown side by side upon a screen

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 画面尺寸由光量决定
content: 投影画面能放多大只取决于可用光量：换用更强光源（如石灰光）而光学结构不变，画面直径可从约六英尺增至十五英尺；若仍用弱光源而只把放映机后移，画面会因光衰减而变成灰影。
quote: the size of such pictures is governed only by the amount of light available

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 北向天光与侧光
content: 拍人像时优先选北向曝光的天光加侧光组合，能获得最细腻的影调；其他朝向的曝光也能出好效果，不必强求北向。
quote: These three views represent forms of skylight and side-light with north exposure, by which all the finest effects possible are obtained

source_ref.title: Photography in the studio and in the field
source_ref.author: Estabrooke, Edward M., 1838-1903

title: 不透明投影需强光源
content: 拍摄/投影不透明物体时，因光损失大，光源强度是首要考虑：优先用石灰光（lime-jet），普通油灯虽可用但效果较差。
quote: a powerful luminant is a matter of prime consideration. A good oil-lantern will do the work--but not so well as the lime-jet.

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 分镜先行定机位
content: 拍摄前把分镜细化到每个镜头的机位角度与画面细节，全部定稿后再进片场；现场按图执行而非即兴发挥，把即兴留给前期设计阶段。
quote: His story boards were astonishingly detailed, including camera angle and every available detail, all finished before he got on the set.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 解放摄影机
content: 拍摄时不要只服务剧情，让摄影机本身成为可被观看的元素：把机位、运动、取景当作与故事并列的表现手段，而非透明记录工具。
quote: Whatever might be going on in the story, there are always other elements to see in the setting, camera, etc.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 地平线即镜头高度
content: 拍摄时画面地平线（水平线）永远与镜头等高，不可像绘画那样任意抬高或压低；构图前先确定镜头高度，即确定了地平线位置。
quote: In photography it is invariable, and is always on a level with the lens of the camera.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 暗色背景提亮主体
content: 拍摄肖像时若想让人物格外明亮突出，可用深色、有叶饰或岩石的暗背景，并让背景景物贴近人物、明度压低，避免出现天空。
quote: there is a dark foliated background which gives great brilliancy to the picture, but no sky is visible.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 等间隔自动曝光
content: 拍摄运动分解时，用自动电控装置按固定且精确记录的时间间隔触发连续曝光，避免手动操作造成间隔不均。
quote: photographed with automatic electro-photographic apparatus at regulated and accurately recorded intervals of time

source_ref.title: The Science of Animal Locomotion (Zoopraxography) An Electro-Photographic Investigation of Consecutive Phases of Animal Movements
source_ref.author: Muybridge, Eadweard, 1830-1904

title: 小光圈提升清晰度
content: 拍摄静物或复杂陈列时，在镜头前加带小圆孔的挡板/光阑收缩孔径，成像更锐利准确；代价是进光量减少，需延长曝光时间。
quote: the glass should be diminished by placing a screen or diaphragm before it, having a small circular hole

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 持续流动的摄影机
content: 摄影机始终处于某种运动中——位移、摇移或改变焦距，避免长时间静止固定，以保持画面的流动感。
quote: The camera is always moving in some way, shifting around, changing its focal length, etc.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 开放机位即道德立场
content: 摄影机的行为方式带有道德含义：采用开放、不武断的机位态度，暗示对世界复杂性的尊重，让专注的观众自行理解世界。
quote: There’s a quality of openness in the way the camera behaves, which has value, moral implications

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 放大需保留细节
content: 放大投影的清晰度必须足以看清被摄物最小细节，否则放大失去检视意义；选设备时以能否呈现最细微处为准。
quote: the pictures were of such fineness that there was no difficulty in viewing their smallest details

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 早期电影以运动为主
content: 早期影片的内容重心是运动本身（海浪拍岸、大象触电等），叙事成分很少；拍摄此类段落时应把运动奇观放在画面中心，不必依赖情节推进。
quote: Early films showed motion – waves crashing, an elephant getting electrocuted – as much or more than they showed narrative.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 早期放映的机位角度
content: 早期放映场所中，观众被安排在能同时看到放映机和银幕画面的斜角位置；若还原早期观影体验，可把观众席设在放映机侧后方，让放映设备进入观众视野。
quote: Early audiences were situated at an angle that allowed them to see the projector as well as the image on screen

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 早期固定机位舞台化
content: 早期电影把摄影机当作舞台观众席：机位固定不动，演员在镜头前像在舞台上一样横向调度，不做推拉摇移；要表现新媒介的复杂性，必须等创作者先摆脱戏剧隐喻后才出现移动镜头与变焦。
quote: The camera was always still, with the action happening in front, as though on stage

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 电影语言需被学习
content: 早期观众必须学习当时尚未成型的电影规则与语言，包括照明、表演、机位安排；因此早期影片的布光与机位应保持直白、可读，避免依赖观众尚未掌握的成规。
quote: early audiences had to learn the rules and language of film, which hadn’t been created yet – lighting, acting, camera placement…

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 景深在艺术摄影中应避免
content: 景深指画面中多个纵深平面同时被清晰呈现；摄影师普遍追求大景深，但在艺术性拍摄中应刻意回避这种全清晰效果。
quote: this quality, greatly sought for in lenses by photographers, is a thing to be carefully avoided in artistic work

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 画外延续的世界
content: 构图时只把世界的一小块纳入画框，并让观众意识到画框之外生活仍在继续；用这种取舍营造诗意现实主义风格。
quote: what you see through the camera is only a tiny chunk of the world, and that life continues outside of the frame

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 三脚架顶须调水平
content: 架设三脚架时，先通过伸缩各腿适应地面高低差，把三脚架顶面调至水平，再安装相机，避免画面倾斜。
quote: When set up for work be sure to have the tripod top level, which may easily be done by adjusting the legs to the inequalities of the ground.

source_ref.title: Photography in the studio and in the field
source_ref.author: Estabrooke, Edward M., 1838-1903

title: 控光量以利拍摄
content: 棚内只引入必要的光量：光少则室温低、无布帘积尘、屋顶坡度防漏，被摄者不觉得刺眼，操作者也省力——控光同时服务舒适与效率。
quote: It is cool, because no more light is admitted than is absolutely necessary.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 单动作单板原则
content: 每张图板只呈现一个动作的连续相位，不与其他图板交叉引用，使每板可独立阅读。
quote: Each plate illustrates the successive phases of a single action

source_ref.title: The Science of Animal Locomotion (Zoopraxography) An Electro-Photographic Investigation of Consecutive Phases of Animal Movements
source_ref.author: Muybridge, Eadweard, 1830-1904

title: 用刻度尺测像物比
content: 测量像长与物长时，在对焦屏上做两个细标记，标记间距即像长；用精确对焦的刻度尺覆盖标记，读出标记间对应的刻度数即物长，据此可算出焦距。
quote: two fine marks are made on the focussing screen, and the distance between these is the length of the image.

source_ref.title: The Barnet Book of Photography: A Collection of Practical Articles
source_ref.author: Various

title: 像距与光量的取舍
content: 灯箱透镜所成的放大像可落在透镜前任意位置、任意大小，但要实际可用，其尺寸（即离透镜的距离）必须与可用光量匹配。
quote: its size, and therefore its distance from the lens, must be regulated by the amount of light at disposal

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 焦距定义与无限远判据
content: 焦距指薄透镜到平行光线汇聚点的距离；当被摄物距离不小于镜头焦距的一千倍时，可视为无限远，此时对焦屏位置差异可忽略。
quote: The focal length or focal distance of a thin lens is the distance between it and the point to which it converges parallel rays.

source_ref.title: The Barnet Book of Photography: A Collection of Practical Articles
source_ref.author: Various

title: 跟拍反转人物位置
content: 用一段跟拍/移动镜头让两个角色的画面位置互换，以运动而非剪辑完成权力关系的倒转。
quote: watch the way that the tracking shot reverses the position of young Charlie and Uncle Charlie.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 明度范围可超黑白
content: 用不等照度布光可把画面明度范围拉得比颜料在黑与白之间的范围更大；现代室内用隐藏光源在檐口上方造亮区、下侧留暗影，明度差常超过黑白极限。
quote: the range in values is often much greater than that represented by black and white

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 正像校正避免倒置
content: 用不透明反射式投影拍人脸等对象时，须在光路中加入校正镜片，使投出的影像正立而非上下颠倒。
quote: a correcting lens was included in the apparatus, so that the face was seen right way up

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 光色溶接转场
content: 用光色渐变可产生溶接（dissolve）式的场景转换效果，不必更换布景，适合段落间的柔和过渡。
quote: Rather wonderful dissolving effects can be produced in this manner without shifting scenery.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 窗景内景背景法
content: 用室内背景时，可在房间一侧开一扇窗向外窥见景物，作为内景背景的经典处理。
quote: is an excellent specimen of an interior background, with a peep out of a window on one side of the room.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 暗箱描图需固定机身
content: 用暗箱在透明纸上描摹景物时，须把仪器牢固固定（如三脚架或窗台夹具），否则手与笔压纸会震动并移位仪器；一旦偏移，很难再对准原方向。
quote: the pressure of the hand and pencil upon the paper tends to shake and displace the instrument

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 短焦近拍的透视压缩
content: 用短焦镜头拍摄过近的物体，会使远景被压缩、与前景比例失真；正确画面中前景与远景的比例必须真实。
quote: he will immediately detect that the drawing is false, and the distance is dwarfed and pushed together as compared with foreground objects

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 简单镜头的对焦补偿
content: 用简单镜头拍摄时，对焦后需把感光板向镜头移近约焦距的1/50，使视觉焦点转为摄影有效光的焦点；物距越近补偿量越大：4倍焦距约1/30、3倍约1/20、2倍约1/13。
quote: the plate must be brought nearer the lens after focussing by about one-fiftieth of the focal length of the lens

source_ref.title: The Barnet Book of Photography: A Collection of Practical Articles
source_ref.author: Various

title: 半透明光圈的实验条件
content: 用蓖麻油浸透的纸制半透明光圈等改良方案未见明显优势，但值得试验，可用于室内拍摄与明亮户外效果。
quote: translucent diaphragms might be tried in indoor work and bright out-door effects.

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 交替侧光显浮雕
content: 用遮板让光从被摄物左右两侧交替切入，可显出纸纹等表面浮雕；任何刮擦或化学处理造成的起伏破坏会立刻显现。
quote: by throwing the light alternately from either side, the relief caused by the grain of the paper is clearly shown

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 眩光光斑的成因
content: 眩光光斑指聚焦屏上比周围视场更亮的圆形亮斑，成因是光圈位置安装不当，或阳光直射镜头后由镜筒内壁反射所致。
quote: By a flare spot is meant a circular spot on the focussing screen, which receives more light than the surrounding field

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 火焰室通风提升亮度
content: 石蜡灯的亮度不只来自燃料，同等程度来自火焰室的良好通风与整体结构设计；设计火焰室时应把通风作为亮度控制手段。
quote: its brilliance is not all due to the paraffine, but quite as much to the careful ventilation and general construction of the flame-chamber

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 水平线位置作范本
content: 研究群像时，可把水平线所处位置作为重点参考，判断其与人物各部位的关系。
quote: is also a good example of the kind of picture for the photographer to study as to the situation of the horizontal line.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 转动基座获得第二变量
content: 确定光照方向后，让雕塑在基座上旋转，可在同一光位下获得第二组差异明显的造型变化，用于比较不同受光面。
quote: the statue may be then turned round on its pedestal, which produces a second set of variations no less considerable than the first.

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 透视由镜头与人物决定
content: 确定背景透视的起点是镜头与被摄者的相对位置：若背景实物真在人物身后并被同时拍摄，二者受同一透视规律支配，因此替代背景也须遵循同一规律。
quote: The conditions of perspective are determined by the situation of the lens and the sitter.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 空气透视常被忽视
content: 绘制画面背景时须处理空气透视（远景的明暗与色彩衰减），这是画师常忽略的一项，缺失会使背景显得平板、缺乏纵深。
quote: Aerial perspective has not been sufficiently attended to by the painters of pictorial backgrounds.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 光决定绘画与雕塑效果
content: 绘画是光的表达，雕塑的最终效果取决于布光；光能改变绘画的明度并极大影响其色彩，因此拍摄绘画或雕塑时先设计光的方向与分布。
quote: Lighting is the master painter and sculptor.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 聚光镜的常见构造
content: 聚光镜由两片或多片玻璃组成，常见形式是两片平凸透镜面对面放置；其作用是把灯的光尽可能多地收集并改变光线方向，使光线穿过前方的画面或幻灯片。
quote: The condenser is made up of two or more glasses, the usual form consisting of two plano-convex lenses placed face to face.

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 聚光镜口径取值
content: 聚光镜直径在四英寸到三英寸之间，最佳尺寸约为三点五英寸；选口径时在收光量与体积之间取中。
quote: The condensers vary from four to three inches in diameter; perhaps the best size is three and a half inches.

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 背景线条须彼此协调
content: 背景中线条之间必须保持和谐一致，线条互不协调是常见且易被察觉的错误，属于透视本身的失误而非背景功能问题。
quote: It is not the fault of perspective in the background where the lines are not in harmony with each other

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 混合背景规则不变
content: 背景为室内墙面加窗外景等混合形式时，透视条件完全相同：镜头以上线条向下、以下线条向上，统一向视点汇聚。
quote: All the lines above the lens must come down, and all that are below must go up.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 水平线切腰定坐姿
content: 背景水平线切过人物腰部，说明取坐姿视点；多人画面中可让其余人物衬在岩石与暗色树丛前。
quote: the horizontal line of the background cuts the waist of the first female figure, showing that the artist was seated.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 非等比示意需声明
content: 若图中各足间距或离地高度未按比例绘制，须在图注中声明其仅为近似值，避免被当作精确测量。
quote: The comparative distances of the feet from each other or from the ground are not drawn to scale

source_ref.title: The Science of Animal Locomotion (Zoopraxography) An Electro-Photographic Investigation of Consecutive Phases of Animal Movements
source_ref.author: Muybridge, Eadweard, 1830-1904

title: 等待期压暗光源
content: 若开映前仍有空档，应关灯或熄灯；石灰光一类可先调到极低亮度，待需要时再开足。
quote: the light may be switched off or turned out, or in the case say of limelight, turned down very low until wanted.

source_ref.title: Optical Projection. Part 1: The Projection of Lantern Slides
source_ref.author: Wright, Lewis, 1838-1905; Wright, Russell Stuart

title: 免毛玻璃的距离标定
content: 若拍摄对象多为近景，可省去毛玻璃对焦屏，改在尾板上标出若干胶片合焦距离刻度，按距离估焦即可，适合艺术性近距抓拍。
quote: There is no necessity for a ground-glass screen, for on the tail-board could be registered various distances, at which the film is in focus

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 固定教室幕如舞台吊幕
content: 若放映在教室等场所长期使用，可做一块刷白的帆布幕，按舞台吊幕的方式悬挂固定。
quote: it might be thought worth while to have a canvas sheet whitewashed, and hung in the same manner that a stage drop-scene is fixed.

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 地平线高度定机位
content: 若背景地平线约在人物胸部高度，说明画者取坐姿、模特站立，即低机位仰视关系；拍摄时可用地平线高度反推机位高低。
quote: with the horizon about as high as the breast, as if the artist had been seated and the model standing during the process of painting.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 无字幕的纯视觉叙事
content: 若要用纯视觉手段讲故事，可在全片大部分段落不使用字幕/对白文字，仅靠画面与表演推进；把字幕的缺席当作视觉叙事能力的检验标准。
quote: Note that there are no subtitles anywhere in the movie until this very end of the film.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 用道具承载身份
content: 表现人物身份丧失时，让关键道具（如制服）承担身份符号功能：失去道具即失去身份，甚至安排角色试图夺回该道具的段落。
quote: When the character gets fired and loses his uniform, it’s like he’s lost his identity. He even tries to steal the uniform back.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 手持感与犹疑运镜
content: 表现人物面对复杂世界时的犹疑与尊重，可让摄影机做小幅、迟疑、不断修正的运动，而非稳定流畅的机械移动，使观众感到摄影机在临场做决定。
quote: You can almost feel the small, nervous decisions that the camera’s making

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 循环动作首尾相接
content: 表现连续循环动作时，让最后一相的足部落位回到第一相的位置，使序列首尾衔接、可无缝循环。
quote: After the last phase illustrated, the feet, during continuous motion, will revert practically to their position in the first phase.

source_ref.title: The Science of Animal Locomotion (Zoopraxography) An Electro-Photographic Investigation of Consecutive Phases of Animal Movements
source_ref.author: Muybridge, Eadweard, 1830-1904

title: 形态越怪越该用图像
content: 被摄物形态越奇特怪异，越应直接以图像呈现而非文字描述，因为文字难以传达其形状。
quote: The more strange and fantastic the forms of his old teapots, the more advantage in having their pictures given instead of their descriptions.

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 物体与镜头同轴对置
content: 被摄画面或物体置于与主灯相连的箱体内，投影镜头须正对被照亮的画面/物体，与其保持同轴对置，以便把影像投到银幕上。
quote: which holds immediately opposite the illuminated picture the lens for projecting its image upon the screen

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 光色换景需技术支撑
content: 要在舞台上实现光色换景，幕后必须具备相应的科学知识与技术条件，否则无法落地。
quote: But before such accomplishments can be realized upon the stage, scientific knowledge must be available behind the scenes.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 增大景深的方法
content: 要增大景深，可缩小光圈，或改用更短焦距的镜头；在毛玻璃上检查影像，若整体不够锐利即缩小光圈。
quote: Depth of definition is increased by using a lens of shorter focal length or by reducing the aperture.

source_ref.title: The Barnet Book of Photography: A Collection of Practical Articles
source_ref.author: Various

title: 强光源透射看纸面
content: 要揭示纸张表面被涂改、补笔或描画的痕迹时，用强光源透射（光穿过墨迹照到纸面），使涂改处一进入焦点即暴露。
quote: The peculiar arrangement of the lights and screen enables the examiner to discover the surface of the paper through the ink

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 透镜散射不可见光
content: 让不可见射线穿过墙或隔屏上的孔洞进入相邻房间，并在孔后放一枚凸透镜把射线向各方向散射，使整个空间充满不可见光。
quote: which might be scattered in all directions by a convex lens placed behind the aperture

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 角色外形高度具体化
content: 让每个角色在外形、阶层、气质上被极其具体地定义，彼此差异巨大，避免角色同质化。
quote: Note how unbelievably concretely each of the characters are defined – they’re hugely different from each other

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 先对焦再调光心
content: 调光心必须在镜头对焦完成之后进行：先抽拉镜头筒使银幕影像清晰，再取出幻灯片与片夹，露出干净光斑来调整光心。
quote: this adjustment _cannot_ be properly made while a slide is in position, and neither can it be made until the lantern has been focussed

source_ref.title: Optical Projection. Part 1: The Projection of Lantern Slides
source_ref.author: Wright, Lewis, 1838-1905; Wright, Russell Stuart

title: 强调三维纵深
content: 调度与机位选择要让观众明确感知到场景的三维性，而非把空间压平为平面构图。
quote: Renoir makes you aware of three-dimensionality

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 实景拍摄替代棚景
content: 追求世界复杂性时，优先在真实地点与真实建筑内拍摄（室内外皆可），避免棚内搭景，以保留环境的真实质感与偶然细节。
quote: He almost always filmed in real places or buildings, whether indoors or outdoors

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 换光色即换景
content: 通过精心匹配灯光颜色与绘景颜色，仅改变光色即可完成整场换景，无需移动布景；例如黄光下的夏日绿树，转为蓝光即成雪地枯树的冬景。
quote: a complete change of scene can be obtained by merely changing the color of the light.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 难用光向的补救
content: 遇到东向或东南向等难处理的光向时，用遮光板、纱幕和反光板改造光线，即可在任意光向下拍出好效果，不必因无北向光而遗憾。
quote: Good effects can be produced, however, under any form of light by the use of shades, screens and reflectors

source_ref.title: Photography in the studio and in the field
source_ref.author: Estabrooke, Edward M., 1838-1903

title: 画内音源音乐
content: 配乐不由后期叠加，而由画面内角色发出（唱歌、演奏等），即使用画内音；避免与动作无关的叠加配乐。
quote: The music in the scene is generated by an actor within the scene, whether by singing, instrument, etc.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 针孔孔径与板距对应
content: 针孔直径与感光板距离需配对以获得最清晰影像：1/16英寸对应64英寸、1/22对应32、1/32对应16、1/45对应8、1/64对应4。

source_ref.title: The Barnet Book of Photography: A Collection of Practical Articles
source_ref.author: Various

title: 镜头忌强光与久暗
content: 镜头不可置于强烈阳光下，强光会使其发生变化；某些情况下黑暗也有害，因黑暗会使粘合镜片的加拿大树胶变质。
quote: Lenses should not be left in bright sunlight, for this causes a change that slows them, the dark also injures them in certain cases

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 镜头须防划伤与污渍
content: 镜头属精密光学器件，必须妥善保护：应无划痕、条纹、抛光不良造成的暗斑与纹路；灰尘污垢虽不严重损害清晰度，但会挡掉大量光线，如同脏窗与净窗的进光差别。
quote: A good lens should be free from scratches, striations, dull patches, due to imperfect polishing, and veins

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 透视汇聚于视点
content: 镜头所在水平线上、画面中心即视点，所有非垂直非水平的线条都向该点汇聚：低于镜头的线向上收，高于镜头的线向下收，比例正确则透视正确。
quote: Right across the lens is the horizontal line, and the centre is the point of sight, where all the lines will appear to converge.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 光圈定义
content: 镜头的光圈指其能接收并透过的光柱直径；若光阑位于镜头前方，光阑孔径即光圈，若光阑位于镜头后方、光线先经过镜片，则因镜片聚光，实际光圈大于光阑孔径。
quote: The "aperture" of a lens is the diameter of the cylinder of light that it can receive and transmit.

source_ref.title: The Barnet Book of Photography: A Collection of Practical Articles
source_ref.author: Various

title: 放大率与焦距关系
content: 镜头的放大倍率由焦距乘以镜头到银幕的距离决定；焦距越短、投距越远，放大倍率越大。
quote: The magnifying power of a lens depends upon its 'focus' multiplied by its distance from the screen

source_ref.title: Optical Projection. Part 1: The Projection of Lantern Slides
source_ref.author: Wright, Lewis, 1838-1905; Wright, Russell Stuart

title: 视角由底边与焦距决定
content: 镜头视角由画面底边长度与镜头焦距两个因素决定：以底边实长画水平线，从其中点作长度等于焦距的垂线，连成三角形，两腰夹角即视角，可用量角器量出。
quote: The angle depends on two factors, the length of the base line of the picture, and the focal length of the lens.

source_ref.title: Naturalistic Photography for Students of the Art.
source_ref.author: Emerson, P. H. (Peter Henry), 1856-1936

title: 日光色灯光的实现
content: 需要人工日光时，用白炽灯加有色玻璃滤光：白炽光黄橙红偏多，用掺化学剂的有色玻璃滤掉多余黄橙红，使透射光光谱与日光一致。
quote: The light from the electric filament lamp is richer in yellow, orange, and red rays than daylight

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 北天光偏蓝的特性
content: 需要冷调蓝白光源时用北天光：它含过量紫、蓝、蓝绿射线，呈蓝白色，适合表现清冷、阴天的光感。
quote: North skylight contains an excess of violet, blue, and blue-green rays and as a consequence is a bluish white.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 纯顶光布光
content: 需要均匀、无侧向塑形的人像时，可用纯顶光方案：只保留顶部光源、完全不加侧光，如萨罗尼影棚的做法。
quote: The studio of Sarony, of New York, is lighted with a top light similar to the top light of the Biglow studio, and without any side light at all.

source_ref.title: Photography in the studio and in the field
source_ref.author: Estabrooke, Edward M., 1838-1903

title: 曝光间隔可调范围
content: 需要捕捉快速动作时把曝光间隔缩到千分之十七秒量级；动作缓慢或需长间隔时，可把间隔拉长到数秒，间隔按被摄动作速度自由设定。
quote: These intervals could be varied at will from seventeen one-thousandth parts of a second to several seconds.

source_ref.title: The Science of Animal Locomotion (Zoopraxography) An Electro-Photographic Investigation of Consecutive Phases of Animal Movements
source_ref.author: Muybridge, Eadweard, 1830-1904

title: 单色光强化细节
content: 需要最大程度呈现细节纹理时（如显微摄影），改用单色光照明，以牺牲色彩换取细节还原。
quote: Monochromatic light is utilized in photo-micrography for the best rendition of detail.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 报纸作测试标板
content: 需要检验镜头解析力时，用钉在平墙上的报纸作测试物，相机固定不动，逐支镜头仔细对焦后各拍一张底片，再比较成像。
quote: The best test object that is always at hand is a newspaper pinned flat against a flat wall. The camera must not be moved during the work.

source_ref.title: The Barnet Book of Photography: A Collection of Practical Articles
source_ref.author: Various

title: 并置放大比对
content: 需要比对两份相似物（签名、钞票等）时，把两件原物并排置于同一画面内同时放大投影，让差异在并置中直接显现，而不是先后单独展示。
quote: images of the two signatures, enormously magnified, were thrown side by side upon a screen

source_ref.title: The magic lantern and its management
source_ref.author: Hepworth, Thomas Cradock, -1905

title: 摄影机随动拍摄
content: 需要表现人物失衡或移动时，可把摄影机固定在移动载体上（电梯、自行车）或绑在演员身上随其晃动，用机身的运动直接传递体感，而非只用固定机位拍。
quote: There are moments when the camera sits on an elevator or on a moving bicycle – this was highly revolutionary at the time.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 抛物面镜聚焦平行光
content: 需要高平行度光束时，把光源放在抛物面镜焦点上，镜面将焦点发出的光线反射为平行或近似平行光；光源偏离焦点会破坏平行度。
quote: The parabolic mirror has the property of rendering parallel, or nearly so, the rays from a light-source placed at its focus.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 光比颜料色域更宽
content: 需要高纯度色相时用光（甚至光谱色）而非颜料或反射介质；颜料无法得到纯色，因此彩色光可提供比反射介质更饱和的色彩。
quote: It is impossible to obtain pure hues by means of pigments or of other reflecting media.

source_ref.title: Artificial Light: Its Influence upon Civilization
source_ref.author: Luckiesh, Matthew, 1883-1967

title: 异厂镜头需实测
content: 非上述品牌的镜头没有品质一致的保证，选型时必须经过思考与实验，逐支测试后再决定。
quote: It is not so, however, with any other make of lenses

source_ref.title: Photography in the studio and in the field
source_ref.author: Estabrooke, Edward M., 1838-1903

title: 现代观众的多任务剪辑
content: 面向现代观众时，可同时叠加多种信息通道：摄影机运动与主体运动并行、音乐与画面事件不同步、极快的剪辑节奏；这种复杂度是早期观众无法处理的。
quote: In modern film we can see the camera move while the subject moves, music that doesn’t match the events on screen, very fast editing, etc.

source_ref.title: MIT 21L.011 The Film Experience - 2006 lecture notes
source_ref.author: MIT OpenCourseWare (David Thorburn)

title: 相机一次成像全收录
content: 面对数量多、排列复杂的被摄物，不必逐件分拍，让相机一次性把视野内所有物体同时记录在同一画面中。
quote: however numerous the objects—however complicated the arrangement—the Camera depicts them all at once.

source_ref.title: The Pencil of Nature
source_ref.author: Talbot, William Henry Fox, 1800-1877

title: 天空只留一角
content: 风景加建筑背景中，天空可只留画面一角（如右上角）少量露出，其余由景物填满。
quote: has a landscape and architectural background, with a very little sky visible in the right-hand corner.

source_ref.title: The Evolution of Photography With a Chronological Record of Discoveries, Inventions, Etc., Contributions to Photographic Literature, and Personal Reminescences Extending over Forty Years
source_ref.author: Werge, John, active 1854-1890

title: 实景层替代绘制背景
content: Fleischer的setback摄影系统用真实三维布景作为角色表演的背景层，使二维角色能与被实际打光的实体环境同框，从而获得真实光照。
quote: the Fleischer setback camera system used actual three-dimensional sets against which characters like Popeye could perform

source_ref.title: Illuminated Pixels: The Why, What, and How of Digital Lighting - Book Review
source_ref.author: Harvey Deneroff

title: 多层摄影机扩展光效
content: 多层摄影机让二维动画能制造更丰富的光照效果：把画面分层并分别控制各层曝光与运动，即可获得单层绘制做不到的光影变化。
quote: Achmed also pioneered the use of the multiplane camera, which seems to have enabled her to provide for a greater range of lighting effects.

source_ref.title: Illuminated Pixels: The Why, What, and How of Digital Lighting - Book Review
source_ref.author: Harvey Deneroff

title: 多层摄影机强化风景
content: 用多层摄影机拍摄风景开场时，通过分层移动与景深差异可显著增强森林等场景的如画感，如《小鹿斑比》开场的长跟拍。
quote: consider the spectacular opening tracking shot in Bambi where the Disney multiplane camera greatly enhances the picturesque forest scene.

source_ref.title: Illuminated Pixels: The Why, What, and How of Digital Lighting - Book Review
source_ref.author: Harvey Deneroff

title: POV 属取景手法之一
content: POV 镜头是取景（camera framing）体系中的一种，应与景别、角度、运镜组合使用以增强冲击力。
quote: Browse camera framing techniques, and learn how to combine them with other shots, angles and camera movements for impact.

source_ref.title: The Point of View Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: POV 镜头的定义
content: POV 镜头是把观众直接放进角色头部的拍法：摄影机代表角色的眼睛，画面即角色所见，用于让观众与角色共享视角与处境。
quote: A POV shot movie that puts us directly inside a character's head

source_ref.title: The Point of View Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 简单器材也能完成表达
content: 不必依赖摇臂和爆炸场面，一台摄影机加三脚架，配合一次摇镜和一个恰当的广角，就能完成充分表达。
quote: Filmmakers don’t always need cranes and explosions. Sometimes a pan, and the right wide shot, does it all.

source_ref.title: The Wide Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 推轨与变焦的区分
content: 两者都能让主体在画面中变大，但推轨是摄影机本身向主体靠近或远离，变焦是改变镜头焦距放大影像而机位不动；判断依据是机位是否发生位移。
quote: A dolly shot moves the camera towards or away from the subject.

source_ref.title: The Dolly Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 中近景的取景范围
content: 中近景（MCU）取景从人物头顶上方一点到躯干中部，既保留面部表情与情绪，又保留部分背景信息。
quote: A medium close-up shot (or MCU) is a shot that frames the subject from just above their head down to about midway on their torso.

source_ref.title: The Medium Close-Up Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 摇镜跟随代替移动
content: 人物走动时只用最基础的摇镜跟随，不推轨不移动，让观众与观察者一同被钉在原地，只能看不能帮。
quote: No dolly shot, just a pivot.

source_ref.title: The Wide Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 机位角度决定含义
content: 仅掌握景别不够；机位角度及其角度大小会彻底改变镜头的含义，需与景别配合设计。
quote: Camera angles, and degree of those angles, can totally change the meaning of a film shot.

source_ref.title: The Ultimate Guide to Camera Shots
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 用运动让观众认同角色
content: 仅靠摄影机运动也能推动观众与角色产生认同：把移动车运动设计成带观众进入角色世界的路径，而非单纯炫技。
keywords: 用运动让观众认同角色
quote: It can be difficult to push your audience to identify with the characters while only using camera movement. But it is possible.

source_ref.title: The Dolly Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 俯仰表达权力关系
content: 从一角色视角向下俯拍另一角色，用高角度视点视觉化地表示优越，是表现权力与脆弱对比的有效手段。
quote: Tilting the camera down from the perspective of one character to another visually indicates superiority from the higher angle point of view.

source_ref.title: The Tilt Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 仰角拍权力关系
content: 仰角镜头从角色视线下方取景，用于强调角色间的权力关系：对一方用仰角时，常对另一方配以俯角，形成权力对比。
quote: a low angle shot on one character is often paired with a high angle shot on the other character.

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shot Angles in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 仰角表达优越与恐惧
content: 仰角镜头适合表现优越感，或引发恐惧与不安的情绪；当角色强大或自觉强大时，在分镜表中安排仰角以增加含义。
quote: Low angle camera shots are a perfect camera angle for signaling superiority or to elicit feelings of fear and dread.

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shot Angles in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 角度可叠加使用
content: 低角度只是众多机位角度之一，可与其他角度组合使用以获得额外的视觉效果。
quote: A low angle shot is just one of the many camera angles possible and can even be combined for additional effect.

source_ref.title: The Low-Angle Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 低角度表现脆弱
content: 低角度并非只表现强势，也可用来暗示角色的脆弱，需结合情境与表演选择使用。
quote: They can make a hero seem vulnerable

source_ref.title: The Low-Angle Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 极特写的三种动机
content: 使用极特写需有明确叙事理由，常见三类：聚焦主体的某一特定部位、标示场景中重要的感官瞬间、传达小到难以察觉的细节。
quote: To focus in on a specific portion of the subject.

source_ref.title: Extreme Close-Up Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 俯仰揭示的叙事弹性
content: 俯仰可揭示的不止角色与地理，按叙事需要可揭示更多信息，喜剧与恐怖类型中尤其常用。
quote: This is often useful in comedy, or even horror.

source_ref.title: The Tilt Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 俯仰镜头的实现方式
content: 俯仰镜头不依赖移轴镜头，只要把摄影机架在三脚架或手持，直接向上或向下改变俯仰角即可完成。
quote: As long as the camera is mounted on a tripod or handheld, simply angle it up or down.

source_ref.title: The Tilt Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 俯角制造低劣感
content: 俯角镜头让摄影机向下对着被摄主体，通常制造低劣感或“俯视”被摄者的效果；但与其他角度一样，其用法有多种变化。
quote: In a high angle shot, the camera points down at your subject. It usually creates a feeling of inferiority

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shot Angles in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 光线与机位定调
content: 光线提示与机位共同决定画面情绪，拍摄前须确认二者服务于目标基调，而非随意摆放。
quote: Lighting cues and camera placement really affect the mood you get, so make sure your work reflects the specific tone you're aiming for.

source_ref.title: The High-Angle Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 分像屈光镜慎用
content: 分像屈光镜画面高度风格化且不自然，会自我凸显；因人眼无法同时深焦与浅焦，故只在有明确意图时谨慎使用。
quote: This is a highly stylized shot and tends to draw attention to itself because it is "unnatural."

source_ref.title: The Ultimate Guide to Camera Shots
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 景别各有功能需配合使用
content: 分镜时先明确每个景别的功能与目的，再让不同景别在同一场戏里协同，才能写出更好的镜头清单、拍出更好的场景。
quote: Each size has a function and purpose so the sooner we understand how they all work together, the better shot lists we can make

source_ref.title: The Close-Up Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 递进式特写强化反应
content: 切回人物反应时用比上一次更近的特写，逐次逼近以加深观众与角色的情绪连接。
quote: Spielberg bounces back to Schindler for another close up so we can connect to his reaction. But this time, we get even closer.

source_ref.title: The Wide Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 双人镜可调控观众情绪
content: 双人镜本身不限定情绪，改变机位（高度、角度、距离）即可引导观众对两人关系的感受，因此同一场戏可用不同双人镜变体表达不同情绪。
quote: By using the two shot and altering the camera’s position, you can direct the mood and feelings of the audience. The two shot is versatile.

source_ref.title: The Two Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 反打不是运动
content: 反打属于镜头组接方式而非运动类型：先拍角色看向某人或某物的镜头，再接他所看到的内容，即为反打。
quote: A reverse shot is a type of filmmaking shot setup, and isn't defined by movement.

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shots and Sizes in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 大特写呈现转变
content: 可用大特写把角色的转变具象化，例如直接展示身体上长出的羽毛等细节。
quote: Aronofsky uses the extreme close-up shot size to show feathers growing on Nina’s back.

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shots and Sizes in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 推镜制造叙事反差
content: 可用大远景起幅并持续推镜，先给出开阔自由的表象，再让后续内容与之形成叙事反差，从而反转观众预期。
quote: It’s starts as a wide shot, pushing in, taking the audience on a ride through the mountains.

source_ref.title: The Establishing Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 用机位角度强化情绪
content: 可通过调整摄影机角度为特写增加额外的情绪效果，而非只用平视常规角度拍摄。
quote: how you angle your camera to get an added emotional effect

source_ref.title: The Close-Up Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 多角度同拍与组合
content: 同一场景可同时用多个机位角度拍摄以放大电影感与情绪；导演也可组合不同角度来增强效果。
quote: A scene may be shot simultaneously from multiple camera angles to amplify the cinematic effect and the emotions.

source_ref.title: The Ultimate Guide to Camera Shots
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 过肩推进亲密感
content: 在传统过肩正反打基础上，通过缩短机位距离或增加切换频率，让对话戏在常规构图中叠加一层亲密感，并推动场景情绪递进。
quote: David O. Russell slips into the traditional OTS shots here but there’s an added level of intimacy.

source_ref.title: The Over-the-Shoulder Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 插入镜头强调细节
content: 在恰当时机插入特写镜头，用来强调关键细节，例如颤抖的手或有意义的物件。
quote: A well-timed insert shot can emphasize crucial details, such as a trembling hand or a meaningful object.

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shots and Sizes in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 手持与跳切并用
content: 在法国新浪潮式段落中，可将手持镜头与跳切结合使用，以制造断裂、躁动的节奏，这种组合当时被视为非正统。
quote: Godard’s use of both hand held shots and jump cuts were both a point of criticism and praise.

source_ref.title: The Handheld Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 极特写呈现证据
content: 在犯罪题材中，可用极特写展示关键物证，让观众据此自行推测案情，兼具实用与主题功能。
quote: they use extreme close-ups to show important pieces of evidence that give the viewer theories surrounding the crime.

source_ref.title: Extreme Close-Up Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 纵深移焦制造悬念
content: 在长走廊等纵深空间里，可让焦点在前景、中景、背景之间来回转移，用焦点在空间层次间的往返制造紧张与悬念。
quote: we pull focus from foreground to middle ground, to the background, and back to the foreground again.

source_ref.title: The Rack Focus Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 外景过肩转向亲密
content: 场景从室内转到室外后，过肩镜头应转向表现两人之间的亲密互动（如拥抱、打闹），用空间变化带动镜头语义变化。
quote: As soon as we move outside, the over the shoulder shots are about the intimacy between them.

source_ref.title: The Over-the-Shoulder Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 结尾互看过肩收束
content: 场景收尾时，用两人各自越过对方肩膀看向外部世界的过肩镜头，把私人关系与外部现实并置，完成段落收束。
quote: By the end of the scene, we’re showing each of them looking over the shoulder at the other as they deal with the real world.

source_ref.title: The Over-the-Shoulder Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 大特写跨类型通用
content: 大特写不限于某一类型，喜剧等多种电影类型中同样可以使用。
quote: Extreme close-ups can be used in many different film genres, including comedy as well.

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shots and Sizes in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 大特写的常见对象
content: 大特写常拍眼睛、枪的扳机与嘴唇；为获得更高细节可用微距镜头拍摄。
quote: This camera shot size often shows eyes, gun triggers, and lips. Extreme close-up shots are sometimes shot with a macro lens for greater detail.

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shots and Sizes in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 大特写填满画面
content: 大特写（ECU）让主体填满整个画面，近到能呈现平时难以看清的微小细节，主体周围几乎不留呼吸空间。
quote: An extreme close-up shot is a type of camera shot size in film that fills the frame with your subject.

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shots and Sizes in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 广角保持距离塑造母题
content: 始终用广角拍同一对象，使其与观众保持距离，形成视觉母题，强化其神秘、纯真与脆弱感。
quote: The choice to show the girl in wide shots allows Spielberg to keep her at a distance — which created a visual motif.

source_ref.title: The Wide Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 移动镜头的四种机制
content: 实现摄影机运动基本只有四种机制：手持、斯坦尼康、摇臂、移动车（dolly）；需要稳定平滑的位移时选移动车，需要灵活贴身跟拍时选手持或斯坦尼康。
quote: camera movement is achieved with one of the following mechanisms: a handheld shot, a Steadicam shot, a crane shot, or a dolly shot.

source_ref.title: The Dolly Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 延迟切过肩制造悬念
content: 对话戏可先用中景长时间停留（如两分钟）再切入过肩，用延迟切换把普通对话变成神秘感，切点本身成为叙事事件。
quote: Watch how this scene holds on a medium shot of Butch for two entire minutes before cutting to an over-the-shoulder shot.

source_ref.title: The Over-the-Shoulder Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 中近景的选用理由
content: 导演选用中近景的三个理由：捕捉演员表演、保留主体周围背景、作为标准覆盖中的中性选项。
quote: To capture the actor's performance

source_ref.title: The Medium Close-Up Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 取景手法清单
content: 常用取景手法包括：建立镜头、单人镜头、双人/群像镜头、过肩镜头、插入镜头与 POV 镜头，可按叙事需要选用。
quote: Establishing Shots Single Shot Two Shot / Group Shot Over-the-Shoulder (OTS) Insert Shot POV Shot

source_ref.title: The Point of View Shot
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 九种基础景别清单
content: 常用基础景别共九种：大远景/远景、全景、中远景、中景、中近景、特写、大特写、过肩镜头、主观镜头；景别总数可超三十种，但通常按这九到十二种归类。
quote: The top 9 types of camera shots are fundamental in filmmaking. Here are the 9 types of camera shots:

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shots and Sizes in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 运动类型清单
content: 常用镜头运动类型包括：横摇、纵摇、推镜、拉镜、变焦、移焦推拉（Dolly Zoom）、滚转、跟拍、弧形运动、升降臂、手持、鸟瞰。
quote:
Pan
Tilt
Push in
Pull Out
Zoom
Dolly Zoom
Roll
Tracking
Arc
Boom
Handheld
Bird’s Eye

source_ref.title: Different Types of Camera Movements in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 平视不如肩高常见
content: 平视镜头实际使用频率低于直觉预期，因为导演常把机位放在肩部高度以获得更具电影感的画面；需要中性写实时用平视，需要电影感时改用肩高。
quote: directors often prefer to place the camera at shoulder level to attain a much more cinematic look.

source_ref.title: Types of Camera Shot Angles in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 广角需在镜头清单中预设
